correctness.rationale: The minimal-true-input antichains recover both local S5 classes because of transversality. Recovered equivalence blocks form a bipartite incidence multigraph whose proper colourings are in bijection with all alternative ordered S5 representations; connected components coincide with the join of the two equivalences. There are exactly two colourings per component. Each component needs at least four worlds by two distinct opposing neighbours per block; disjoint rectangular grids with duplicates attain the bound and exhibit size-eight nonglobal ambiguity. Exhaustive Boolean operation comparison for all partition pairs through six worlds and explicit sharp constructions through twelve worlds passed; tests supplement the proof.
